text:
eng-release-mgr: Quick heads up — we need a prod push tonight to roll back the v2.4.1 hotfix (regression). Change window 23:00-01:00 UTC. Who can press? MFA + JIT required.

liz: I'm oncall but I don't have deploy keys for prod (only staging). happy to coordinate.

kevin: I can press but I need a JIT grant. IAM ticket #9876 is open, waiting approval from sec.

maria: Is rollback to v2.4.0 still safe? I'd prefer pin and patch instead of forward deploy.

eng-release-mgr: Ideally pin to 2.4.0-hotfix, yes. But ops wants a quick rollback to reduce user impact. Need someone who can press and own the rollback checklist.

jordan: I can be second pair of eyes for the rollback (can watch canary and metrics). not able to press.

anita: Heads-up — if we use breakglass persona we lose audit attribution. prefer explicit JIT.

kevin: Can SRE-oncall approve the JIT? otherwise I can't get the token in time.

sre-oncall: I can approve the JIT for up to 2 hours. Please post the minimal justification and link to the runbook.

eng-release-mgr: Runbook link: https://redwood.dev/playbooks/prod-rollback. Minimal justification: "rollback v2.4.1 due to regression causing failed embeddings (high error rate)".

liz: tagging deploy-bot to check which deployers have permission: @deploy-bot who_can_press prod?

deploy-bot: Automated: Permission audit - users with deploy:press on prod: kevin, deploy-team-lead, ops-svc (svcacct). LastPress: 3765400000 by deploy-team-lead.

anita: kevin, if sec approves IAM ticket, please paste the JIT token expiry and I'll schedule the canary.

kevin: ack. Sec approved via ticket comment. JIT token good for 1h starting 22:55 UTC. Will paste token after obtaining CLI access.

eng-release-mgr: Canary plan: press to rollback to 2.4.0-hotfix on a small subset (5% traffic), monitor error-rate, latency, and embeddings-accuracy, then ramp to 50% after 10m if green. If regressions persist, re-open rollback.

jordan: reminder: add config pin in deployment manifest: `image: redwood/api:v2.4.0-hotfix` before pressing.

liz: +1 on manifest pin. Also patch release notes: add note about user-facing regression and rollback.

kevin: pasting command i'll run: ```
# initiate rollback
deployer press --env=prod --image=redwood/api:v2.4.0-hotfix --canary=5% --change-window=23:00-01:00
```

deploy-bot: Deploybot: queued rollback job 3765432110, waiting for MFA confirmation from kevin.

kevin: MFA done. pressing now. :rocket:

deploy-bot: Rolling back: step1 apply manifest pin -> success; step2 deploy canary -> success; step3 health checks -> passing. Canary metrics: error-rate down 78%, latency +10ms.

anita: monitoring looks good. ramping to 50% in 2m.

jordan: after ramp, we'll validate regression suite and embeddings QA set.

eng-release-mgr: Great job team. Post-mortem: action item to add runbook step to ensure deploy keys coverage for oncall. Also open follow-up to consider automated pin fallback if regression > threshold.

liz: noted. filing follow-up ticket. :memo: 

kevin: thanks all.

deploy-bot: Completed rollback job 3765432110 at 3765432335. Audit: actor=kevin, method=jit+mfa, duration=40m.
